name: Lamp Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a table lamp whose glowing yellow bulb peers out with lens eyes under a pale shade, shining a cone of light
entry: It lights the way for lost travellers at night, then switches off just before they get home.
how: Use a Light Bulb on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Dazzling Gleam in this form.
